title: DatabaseSchema
description: Validates the upsert validation schema YAML (converted to JSON for validation)

rootDataPath.description: Base directory for resolving data file paths; relative to the schema file's directory. Defaults to the current working directory if omitted and not overridden by the CLI.

rootOutputPath.description: Base directory for resolving generated SQL output file paths; relative to the schema file's directory. Defaults to the current working directory if omitted and not overridden by the CLI.

defaultNullable.description: If true, columns are nullable unless a required constraint is present

strictFields.description: If true, unknown fields in data files cause validation failure

dataFiles.description: List of data file paths for this table, resolved relative to rootDataPath. An empty list skips processing for this table.

outputFile.description: Output SQL file name for this table, resolved relative to rootOutputPath. Defaults to '<tableName>.sql' if omitted. Multiple tables may share the same outputFile, in which case their generated statements are written to the same file.

primaryKey.description: List of column names that form the primary key

batchSize.description: Rows per multi-row 'INSERT ... VALUES (...), (...)' statement. 1 (default) = one statement per row. 0 = no limit (as many rows as possible in one statement, still split when required by ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE semantics).

target.description: Column(s) used in ON CONFLICT (...) clause. Mutually exclusive with constraint.

constraint.description: Named constraint used in ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT ... . Mutually exclusive with target.

action.description: DO UPDATE or DO NOTHING on conflict

datatype.description: SQL type string e.g. VARCHAR(30), INTEGER, NUMERIC(8,2)

onConflict.description: DO UPDATE SET strategy for this column. OVERWRITE = EXCLUDED wins; PRESERVE = omitted from SET (old value wins); COALESCE = EXCLUDED wins unless NULL; COMPUTED = always re-renders this column's `default`, ignoring EXCLUDED (requires a non-GENERATOR default).

kind.description: LITERAL = quoted value, FUNCTION = unquoted SQL function, EXPRESSION = raw SQL, GENERATOR = built-in generator, AUTO = column omitted entirely from INSERT/UPDATE and left to the database (identity, DEFAULT, or trigger)

value.description: The literal value, function name, SQL expression, or built-in generator. Not used (and should be omitted) for AUTO.

args.description: Optional arguments passed to a FUNCTION type default

schema.description: Schema qualifier — inherits top-level schema if omitted

ForeignKeyAction.description: PostgreSQL referential action — defaults to noAction if omitted

message.description: Human-readable message shown when this constraint fails

conflictTarget.description: If true, this constraint drives the ON CONFLICT target clause

values.description: Allowed values — data value must be one of these

regex.description: Regular expression the column value must match

notFuture.description: If true, rejects timestamps after validation runtime

notPast.description: ISO 8601 negative duration — e.g. -P4Y means no older than 4 years
